newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt to invite bids for a 300-km gas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Egypt to invite bids for a 300-km gas pipeline.

text.p: The Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC) will invite international bidders within the coming few days to submit bids to build a 300 km (160 mile) pipeline to carry natural gas from the Western Desert to the national grid, an EGPC official said on Sunday.

The official, who asked not to be named, said that natural gas production from the Western Desert's Salam and Obayyed fields would be connected with the Egyptian national grid near the Mediterranean port city of Alexandria.
The two new fields are operated by Shell and Repsol Exploration Egipto, a subsidiary of Spanish Repsol.
The official said the daily production would reach some 500 million cubic feet. He did not set a date.
The tender will include building the pipeline and construction of a gas treatment and condensate separation plant, the official said.
